qss.chat: #LyrixaChatDisplay { background: ${bg_panel_glass}; border: 1px solid ${accent_primary}; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px; font-family: ${font_mono}; }
qss.inputs: QLineEdit { background: #142536; border: 1px solid ${accent_primary}; border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 10px; color: ${text_primary}; font-family: ${font_mono}; } QLineEdit:focus { border-color: ${accent_secondary}; }
qss.buttons: QPushButton.cyber { background: qlineargradient(x1:0,y1:0,x2:1,y2:1, stop:0 ${accent_primary}, stop:1 ${accent_secondary}); color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid ${accent_primary}; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 18px; font-weight: 600; font-family: ${font_ui}; } QPushButton.cyber:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 8px ${accent_primary}; border-color: ${accent_secondary}; } QPushButton.cyber:pressed { background: ${accent_secondary}; }
